collection.title: Rover 75 Estate 1999 to 2005 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Rover 75 Estate 1999 to 2005 requires a 22" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Rover 75 which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
